name: Gracie Style Academy
description: Structured self-defense classes with clear steps, lots of posture reminders, and bow-in etiquette.
quirk: You hear the phrase base and posture at least 12 times per class.
vibe: Calm but formal. White belts are guided closely.

name: Cage Blend MMA
description: Nogi-heavy room with wrestlers, fighters, and a little chaos in every round.
quirk: Warmups can accidentally become conditioning tests.
vibe: Fast pace, loud timer, sink or learn energy.

name: Sport Jiu Jitsu Lab
description: Competition-oriented technical room with positional chains and ceremony-like class cadence.
quirk: People discuss lapel grips the way others discuss weather.
vibe: Technical and focused, with detail-heavy coaching.
